title: Fatima Jinnah Women University Rawalpindi Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Fatima Jinnah Women University Rawalpindi Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 2004
ACT VIII OF 2004
FATIMA JINNAH
WOMEN UNIVERSITY, RAWALPINDI
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
2004
An Act to amend
the Fatima Jinnah Women University
Rawalpindi
Ordinance, 1999
[Gazette of the
Punjab (Extraordinary), dated 25th February, 2004]
No.PAP-LEGIS-2(23)/2003/581,
dated 23-2-2004.---------The Fatima Jinnah Women University, Rawalpindi
(Amendment) Bill 2003, having been passed., by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on 8th January, 2004, and assented to by the. Governor of the Punjab on
19th February, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Fatima Jinnah Women
University, Rawalpindi (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

(Amendment) Bill 2003, having been passed., by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on 8th January, 2004, and assented to by the. Governor of the Punjab on
19th February, 2004, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab.
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
2. Amendment in section 8 of
Ordinance XLIII of 1999.------In the said Ordinance, in section 8, after
subsection (6), the following new subsection (7) shall be added:--
"(7) In the
performance of his functions under this Ordinance, the Chancellor shall act and
be bound in the same manner as the Governor of a Province acts and is bound
under Article 105 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan."
